_comment: Interactive phasor calculator. AutoForm over _PhasorCalcModel: a Controls panel (frequency, harmonic, reference lifetimes, FRET + two-component overlays) beside a phasor plot that draws the universal semicircle plus the selected reference geometry.

sections.label: Frequency
sections.description: Modulation frequency used to map lifetimes onto the phasor plot.

sections.label: Harmonic
sections.description: Harmonic number; the effective frequency is frequency x harmonic.

sections.label: Lifetimes (ns)
sections.description: Comma-separated reference lifetimes (ns) drawn as the iso-lifetime grid and semicircle ticks.

sections.label: Iso-lifetime grid
sections.description: Draw iso-phase and iso-modulation lines for the reference lifetimes.

sections.label: Lifetime ticks
sections.description: Mark the reference lifetimes on the universal semicircle.

sections.label: Polar grid
sections.description: Draw a polar coordinate grid (concentric circles + angular spokes) for reading phase and modulation.

sections.label: FRET trajectory
sections.description: Draw the quenched-donor FRET trajectory for the donor-only lifetime below.

sections.label: Donor tau0
sections.description: Donor-only lifetime for the FRET trajectory (tau_DA = tau_D0 * (1 - E)).

sections.label: Two-component line
sections.description: Draw a mixing line between the two component phasors below.

sections.label: g1
sections.description: Component 1 g.

sections.label: s1
sections.description: Component 1 s.

sections.label: g2
sections.description: Component 2 g.

sections.label: s2
sections.description: Component 2 s.

sections.label: Mixing region
sections.description: Draw the two-component mixing geometry and the fraction-weighted mixture point (uses g1/s1, g2/s2 as the components).

sections.label: Fraction c1
sections.description: Fractional intensity of component 1 (component 2 gets the remainder); sets the mixture point.

sections.label: Cursor
sections.description: Draw a circular gating-cursor outline at the position below.

sections.label: Cursor g
sections.description: Cursor centre g.

sections.label: Cursor s
sections.description: Cursor centre s.

sections.label: Cursor radius
sections.description: Radius of the circular gating cursor.

sections.title: Results
sections.description: Computed apparent lifetimes and mixing fractions for the reference geometry.

sections.title: Phasor plot
sections.description: Universal semicircle with the selected reference-lifetime grid/ticks, FRET trajectory and two-component mixing line.
